examples.english: This year's winner was the youngest ever at twenty-three, and was met with a great round of applause from the audience.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧ (receiving a prize) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Commonly used in news reporting about awards ceremonies, literary prizes, and scientific honors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ノーベル⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}: Nobel Prize laureate
- ⟦{歴代|れきだい}→歴代：13199_rekidai⟧{受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}: past winners
- {受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧: list of winners
- {受賞者|じゅしょうしゃ}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: announcement of winners

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧: winning a prize — the act itself, not the person
- ⟦{入賞者|にゅうしょうしゃ}→入賞者：28365_nyuushousha⟧: prize-placer — someone who placed in a competition (broader than winning first)
- ⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧: candidate, nominee — a person being considered for an award but who has not yet won
